playbookOutputs: Comprehensive SARS Auto Assessment Audit & Reconciliation Report comparing SARS third-party data against your actual tax certificates and eligible deductions
Calculated tax delta showing whether accepting the Auto Assessment leaves a refund unclaimed or creates a compliance risk
Clear written recommendation to either Accept the Auto Assessment or File an Amended ITR12 Return
playbookCommonFailures: Taxpayer has out-of-pocket medical expenses, travel allowance logbook, home office expenses, s18A donations, or rental/commission deductions omitted by SARS Auto Assessment
Employer IRP5 or medical aid / RA third-party data on SARS was incomplete or duplicated when the auto-assessment ran
40-business-day window to file an amended ITR12 after an Auto Assessment has expired, requiring a Request for Extension alongside the return

informationToProvide.label: Full Name, ID Number, SARS Tax Number & Assessment Year
informationToProvide.helpText: Your full name, 13-digit SA ID number, 10-digit SARS tax number, and the tax year of the Auto Assessment.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Taxpayer full name, ID number, SARS tax reference number, and assessment tax year.

informationToProvide.label: Summary of Additional Deductions or Income Not Captured on Auto Assessment
informationToProvide.helpText: Tell us if you have out-of-pocket medical expenses, a travel allowance logbook, s18A donations, home office expenses, solar/wear-and-tear, or freelance/rental income/losses.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client summary of additional deductions or income streams omitted from the SARS auto-assessment.

informationToProvide.label: SARS Auto Assessment Notice (ITA34) or Notification
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the original ITA34 Auto Assessment issued by SARS (or let us pull it via eFiling).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS ITA34 Auto Assessment notice showing the auto-assessed income, deductions, and tax outcome.

informationToProvide.label: All IRP5/IT3(a) & IT3(b)/IT3(c) Tax Certificates for the Year
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload all employment IRP5s and bank/investment IT3(b)/IT3(c) certificates for the tax year.
informationToProvide.aiHint: IRP5, IT3(a), IT3(b), and IT3(c) tax certificates for the assessment year.

informationToProvide.label: Medical Aid Certificate, Out-of-Pocket Medical Proof, RA (IT3(f)) & s18A Certificates
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your medical aid tax certificate, out-of-pocket medical receipts, Retirement Annuity certificates, and s18A donation receipts.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Medical scheme certificate, out-of-pocket medical schedules, RA IT3(f), and s18A donation certificates.

informationToProvide.label: Travel Logbook / Rental / Home Office / Other Supporting Schedules (if applicable)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your vehicle travel logbook or any other deduction schedules you wish us to test against the Auto Assessment.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Vehicle travel logbook, home office calculation, or rental schedule.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect Auto Assessment ITA34, tax certificates and deduction schedules
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Auto Assessment ITA34 (or eFiling access) and all client tax certificates/deduction proofs are on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ensure we have the SARS ITA34 Auto Assessment figures and all IRP5, medical, RA, s18A, and logbook/other deduction records.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify third-party certificates on SARS against actual certificates uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every source code on the Auto Assessment is reconciled against the client's actual certificates
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Compare each source code on the SARS ITA34 Auto Assessment against the uploaded IRP5, IT3(b), Medical Aid, and RA certificates. Identify any missing certificates or uncaptured deductions.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Compute actual ITR12 tax position vs SARS Auto Assessment outcome
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Side-by-side tax calculation completed showing Auto-Assessed outcome vs Amended ITR12 outcome
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Calculate the exact tax refund or liability if an amended ITR12 is filed including all eligible deductions (s18A, out-of-pocket medicals, travel allowance, RA carry-forward, etc.).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft SARS Auto Assessment Review & Recommendation Report
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Written Review Report and recommendation approved by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a clear comparison report showing: (1) SARS Auto-Assessed figures, (2) Actual Audited figures, (3) Additional Refund / Tax Saving identified, and (4) Recommendation whether to accept as-is or proceed with filing an amended ITR12.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver Auto Assessment Review Report and next-step advice
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Review report posted to Communication History with clear next steps
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the review report to Communication History and inform the client of the 40-business-day SARS deadline if an amended ITR12 return is recommended.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the Auto Assessment Review order is complete
